I am eighty years old and I never went to school. This plot is just my small piece behind the house where I plant cassava and cocoyam, and one bag of fertilizer is too much for it anyway. I will not buy chemical fertilizer or those new seeds from town — I do not have that cash — so I will use my own cuttings and put some kitchen compost and ash on the mounds. My grandchildren and I will pull the weeds by hand over about 35 days this season; I will not pay outside workers or spray anything, and the rains here in the south are enough without carrying water.
